Container.Name: wol-relay-container
Container.Overview: Small HTTP relay that sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet when it receives an authenticated POST, for example from Home Assistant. Runs with host networking so the broadcast reaches the target's network segment. No web UI and no stored data; activity is in the container log.

Config.Name: WOL_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Shared secret expected in the X-Auth-Token header. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: WOL_TARGET_MAC
Config.Description: Default target MAC address, e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff. Optional if callers send a mac in the request body.

Config.Name: WOL_LISTEN_PORT
Config.Description: HTTP port. The container uses host networking: this port opens on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log time stamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin

Config.Name: WOL_ALLOW_BODY_MAC
Config.Description: false: refuse a mac in the request body and wake only WOL_TARGET_MAC

Config.Name: WOL_BROADCAST_ADDRESS
Config.Description: Broadcast destination; a subnet broadcast such as 192.168.1.255 also works

Config.Name: WOL_PORT
Config.Description: UDP port of the magic packet (typically 9 or 7)
